# smphe — Semaphore UI CLI

CLI for [Semaphore UI](https://semaphoreui.com/), an open-source web UI for running Ansible, Terraform, Bash, and Python automation tasks.

Package: `@gzl10/semaphore-client`
Install: `npm install -g @gzl10/semaphore-client`

## Setup

```bash
smphe config set host http://semaphore.example.com:3000
smphe login --token YOUR_API_TOKEN
smphe use <projectId>   # set active project for all subsequent commands
```

## Project context

Project ID is resolved in priority order:
1. `--project <id>` flag on any command
2. `SMPHE_PROJECT=<id>` environment variable
3. Active project saved via `smphe use <id>`

## JSON output

All read commands accept `--json` for machine-readable output:

```bash
smphe tasks list --json | jq '.[].status'
smphe templates list --json | jq '.[] | {id, name, playbook}'
```

## Commands

### Setup
```
smphe config set host <url>     Set Semaphore host URL
smphe config set token <token>  Set API token (prefer: smphe login --token)
smphe config show               Show current config
smphe login --token <token>     Save API token to config
smphe use <projectId>           Set active project
```

### Projects
```
smphe projects list
smphe projects get <id>
smphe projects create --name <name>
smphe projects update <id> --name <name>
smphe projects delete <id>
```

### Templates (playbooks / runbooks)
```
smphe templates list
smphe templates get <id>
smphe templates create --name <name> --inventory-id <id> --repository-id <id> --environment-id <id> --playbook <file.yml>
smphe templates update <id> [--name <name>] [--playbook <file>] [--app ansible|terraform|tofu|bash|python|powershell]
smphe templates delete <id>
```

### Tasks (executions)
```
smphe tasks list [--status waiting|running|stopped|error|success]
smphe tasks get <taskId>
smphe tasks run <templateId> [--limit <hosts>] [--debug] [--dry-run] [--playbook <file>] [--environment <json>] [--arguments <str>]
smphe tasks stop <taskId>
smphe tasks output <taskId>
```

`tasks run` returns immediately with `status: "waiting"`. Poll with `tasks get` until `success` or `error`.

### Keys (credentials / SSH keys)
```
smphe keys list
smphe keys get <id>
smphe keys create --name <name> --type none|ssh|login
smphe keys update <id> [--name <name>] [--type none|ssh|login] [--private-key <content>] [--private-key-file <path>] [--login <user>] [--password <pass>]
smphe keys delete <id>
```

### Inventory (host lists)
```
smphe inventory list
smphe inventory get <id>
smphe inventory create --name <name> --inventory <content> --type static|file|static-yaml --ssh-key-id <id>
smphe inventory update <id> [--name <name>] [--inventory <content>] [--type <type>] [--ssh-key-id <id>]
smphe inventory delete <id>
```

### Environment (variable groups / secrets)
```
smphe environment list
smphe environment get <id>
smphe environment create --name <name> [--password <vault-key>]
smphe environment update <id> [--name <name>] [--password <vault-key>]
smphe environment delete <id>
```

`--password` is the ansible-vault encryption key for the variable group, not an auth password.

### Repositories
```
smphe repositories list
smphe repositories get <id>
smphe repositories create --name <name> --git-url <url> --git-branch <branch> --ssh-key-id <id>
smphe repositories update <id> [--name <name>] [--git-url <url>] [--git-branch <branch>] [--ssh-key-id <id>]
smphe repositories delete <id>
```

### Schedules
```
smphe schedules list
smphe schedules get <id>
smphe schedules create --template-id <id> --cron "0 2 * * *"
smphe schedules update <id> [--cron <format>] [--enabled] [--no-enabled]
smphe schedules delete <id>
```

`--no-enabled` pauses a schedule without deleting it. `--enabled` reactivates it.

### Users
```
smphe users list
smphe users get <id>
```

## Typical agent workflow

```bash
# 1. Discover what playbooks are available
smphe templates list --json

# 2. Run a playbook
smphe tasks run 42 --limit webservers --json
# → {"id": 123, "status": "waiting", ...}

# 3. Poll until done
smphe tasks get 123 --json | jq '.status'
# → "running" ... "success"

# 4. Get output on failure
smphe tasks output 123

# 5. Pause a schedule temporarily
smphe schedules update 7 --no-enabled

# 6. Re-enable it
smphe schedules update 7 --enabled
```
